topic: Function Object (Functor) with Default Template Parameters for Custom Comparison
explanation: This concept leverages C++ template features to create flexible, reusable comparison functions that can be customized with user-defined or default comparison strategies. In advanced C programming techniques, this pattern, akin to function pointers but with compile-time polymorphism, enabling efficient and type-safe customization without runtime overhead. Although C itself lacks templates, understanding this pattern is essential for grasping advanced comparison mechanisms and callback strategies in C-like environments or when interfacing with C code.
keywords: Functor, Custom comparison predicate, Default template arguments, Function object C++
